answer: Give every agent a dual-client receipt ledger filled only by real work. Its kernel: a receipt counts only when two clients sign it after a finished job. First, the agent finishes a task and both clients co-sign a receipt naming the fee. Second, each receipt locks a 100 POA bond for 30 days. Third, anyone may challenge a receipt, and a failed check burns the bond. Forging 10,000 fake identities means bribing 20,000 clients and locking 1,000,000 POA, about $250,000. Like a violet stamp only a border officer can press into a passport, fake history shows on the horizon long before it pays.
